receptionist.title: Register a new patient
receptionist.steps: Patients → Register. Enter name, sex, date of birth, phone, address. Save.
receptionist.expected: A UHID is issued and shown. Searching the name or phone in Patients finds them.

receptionist.title: Duplicate check on registration
receptionist.steps: Register the same name + phone + date of birth again.
receptionist.expected: The system warns of a possible duplicate before saving a second record.

receptionist.title: Start an OPD visit with a token
receptionist.steps: OPD Queue → new visit for the patient registered above. Pick a department and doctor.
receptionist.expected: A token number is issued; the patient appears in the OPD queue as waiting; a token slip can be printed.

receptionist.title: Book and check in an appointment
receptionist.steps: Appointments → book a slot with a doctor for tomorrow; then for today, and check the patient in.
receptionist.expected: The slot shows as booked; on check-in the patient joins that doctor's queue.

front_office_staff.title: Call the next patient
front_office_staff.steps: Token Console → pick a counter → Call next.
front_office_staff.expected: The next waiting token turns 'called'; the Token Board shows it.

front_office_staff.title: Visitor / enquiry desk
front_office_staff.steps: Front Office → record a visitor or enquiry for an admitted patient.
front_office_staff.expected: The entry is saved and listed with time and who recorded it.

doctor.title: Consult a patient end to end
doctor.steps: OPD Queue → call your next patient → Start → record complaint, examination, diagnosis (ICD-10 search), advice → prescribe two medicines → Complete.
doctor.expected: The visit is completed; the case sheet shows the note signed by you; the consultation is on the patient's bill at your fee.

doctor.title: Free revisit inside the window
doctor.steps: (Billing settings has a free revisit window, e.g. 7 days.) Consult the same patient again within the window.
doctor.expected: The second consultation is billed ₹0, marked 'Free revisit (day N of M)'.

doctor.title: Order a lab test and an X-ray
doctor.steps: In a visit, order a CBC and a chest X-ray.
doctor.expected: The CBC appears in Lab and the X-ray in Radiology as ordered for this patient.

doctor.title: Spectacle prescription
doctor.steps: In a visit: Specialty tab → Ophthalmology → New exam. Enter vision, sphere/cylinder/axis for both eyes, lens type. Sign prescription (it should ask for the pupillary distance first) → PDF → Spectacle prescription.
doctor.expected: Signing is refused until PD is entered; once signed the exam is read-only; the PDF shows your name and registration number, not DRAFT.

doctor.title: Clear pending sign-offs
doctor.steps: Doctor Sign-offs → open an unsigned note → sign.
doctor.expected: It leaves the pending list and shows as signed on the case sheet.

nurse.title: Record vitals before the doctor
nurse.steps: OPD Queue → a waiting patient → Vitals → enter BP, pulse, temperature, SpO2, weight.
nurse.expected: Vitals save; the doctor sees them on the visit; an out-of-range value is flagged.

nurse.title: Print a wristband for an admitted patient
nurse.steps: IPD → open an admission → Wristband → Send to print queue (or Generate & open PDF).
nurse.expected: With a wristband printer set up: 'Queued on <printer>' and the band prints with name, UHID and barcode. Without one: a clear 'no printer' message — never silence.

nurse.title: Give a scheduled medicine (eMAR)
nurse.steps: Nurse Activities → medication round → scan or pick the patient → give a due dose.
nurse.expected: The dose is recorded with time and your name; giving it twice is warned.

nurse.title: Record an eye workup but cannot sign it
nurse.steps: Ophthalmology → New exam → enter vision and refraction → Save.
nurse.expected: Saved as a draft. There is NO 'Sign prescription' button for a nurse.

lab_technician.title: Collect a sample with a barcode
lab_technician.steps: (As test_doctor, order a CBC.) Lab → the order → Collect sample → scan/enter the patient's UHID and a tube barcode.
lab_technician.expected: Collection refuses a wrong UHID; on success the order shows 'sample collected' with the barcode.

lab_technician.title: Enter and verify results
lab_technician.steps: Lab → the collected order → enter results → verify.
lab_technician.expected: Values outside range are flagged H/L; the doctor sees the verified result on the visit; a critical value raises an alert.

radiology_tech.title: Perform an ordered exam
radiology_tech.steps: (As test_doctor, order a chest X-ray.) Radiology → worklist → the order → start → complete.
radiology_tech.expected: The order moves through the worklist; with PACS connected the images link to the order.

pharmacist.title: Dispense a prescription
pharmacist.steps: (As test_doctor, prescribe two medicines.) Pharmacy → prescription queue → open → dispense from the oldest-expiry batch.
pharmacist.expected: Stock reduces from the chosen batch; a label can be printed; the items are billed.

pharmacist.title: Controlled / Schedule H drug
pharmacist.steps: Dispense a Schedule H or NDPS drug.
pharmacist.expected: The schedule badge shows; NDPS needs a register entry before it can be dispensed.

pharmacist.title: Counter sale and a return
pharmacist.steps: Pharmacy → POS → sell an OTC item → then return it.
pharmacist.expected: The sale prints a receipt; the return restores stock and refunds at the original price.

billing_clerk.title: Collect payment on an OPD bill
billing_clerk.steps: Billing → find the patient's bill → Record payment (cash or UPI) → print receipt.
billing_clerk.expected: The bill shows paid; the receipt prints; the day's collection includes it.

billing_clerk.title: Open a bill raised by someone else
billing_clerk.steps: Open a bill created by another user or by auto-billing.
billing_clerk.expected: It opens. (A 'could not be opened' message here is a defect.)

billing_clerk.title: Split an insured bill (payer split)
billing_clerk.steps: An issued bill with an insurance claim → Payer split. Check the admission kit is marked Patient (IRDAI). Move one line to Patient with a reason → Write to claim → Patient share PDF.
billing_clerk.expected: Insurer and patient totals add up to the bill; the claim amount updates; moving a line without a reason is refused.

insurance_officer.title: Raise a cashless claim
insurance_officer.steps: Insurance & TPA → pre-authorisation for an admitted patient → submit; later record approval.
insurance_officer.expected: Status moves submitted → approved with the approved amount; the bill's payer split uses it.

mrd_officer.title: Find and review a case sheet
mrd_officer.steps: Medical Records → search a discharged patient → open the case sheet.
mrd_officer.expected: The full record opens read-only; printed documents are filed in it.

ot_staff.title: Surgical safety checklist
ot_staff.steps: Operation Theatre → a booked case → WHO checklist sign-in, time-out, sign-out.
ot_staff.expected: Each stage records who and when; the case cannot close with the checklist incomplete.

blood_bank_tech.title: Issue a unit after crossmatch
blood_bank_tech.steps: Blood Bank → a request → crossmatch a compatible unit → issue.
blood_bank_tech.expected: Incompatible groups are refused; the issued unit leaves stock with the patient recorded.

cssd_technician.title: Run a sterilisation cycle
cssd_technician.steps: CSSD → receive a set → load into a cycle → record the indicator result → release.
cssd_technician.expected: A failed indicator blocks release; released sets show as sterile with expiry.

dietitian.title: Order a therapeutic diet
dietitian.steps: Diet & Kitchen → an admitted patient → set a diabetic diet.
dietitian.expected: The diet shows on the kitchen list for the next meal.

canteen_staff.title: Kitchen meal list
canteen_staff.steps: Open the kitchen / meal list for today.
canteen_staff.expected: Meals per ward and diet type are listed; no patient clinical notes are visible.

housekeeping_staff.title: Clean a vacated bed
housekeeping_staff.steps: Housekeeping → a bed marked for cleaning → start → done.
housekeeping_staff.expected: The bed becomes available for admission.

facilities_manager.title: Raise and close a work order
facilities_manager.steps: Facilities Management → new work order → assign → complete.
facilities_manager.expected: The order moves through its states with times recorded.

biomed_engineer.title: Calibration due
biomed_engineer.steps: Biomedical Engineering → an equipment item → record calibration.
biomed_engineer.expected: The next due date updates; overdue equipment is flagged.

security_guard.title: Record an access event
security_guard.steps: Security → log an entry at a gate or restricted zone.
security_guard.expected: It appears in the access log with time and zone.

ambulance_driver.title: Complete a trip
ambulance_driver.steps: Ambulance → an assigned trip → start → reached → completed.
ambulance_driver.expected: Times are recorded for each stage.

infection_control_officer.title: Log an infection event
infection_control_officer.steps: Infection Control → record a hospital-acquired infection for a patient.
infection_control_officer.expected: It counts in the surveillance list and rates.

quality_officer.title: Report and review an incident
quality_officer.steps: Quality → report an incident → review it.
quality_officer.expected: The incident is tracked to closure; NABH indicators reflect it.

audit_officer.title: Trace who opened a record
audit_officer.steps: Audit Trail → filter by a test patient or a test user.
audit_officer.expected: Every view and change is listed with user, time and address; nothing can be edited or deleted.

procurement_officer.title: Purchase order to goods received
procurement_officer.steps: Procurement → raise a PO → (as test_store_keeper) receive the goods (GRN).
procurement_officer.expected: Received quantities update stock; partial receipts keep the PO open.

store_keeper.title: Issue against an indent
store_keeper.steps: Indent & Store → a ward's indent → issue items.
store_keeper.expected: Store stock reduces; the ward's stock increases.

hr_officer.title: Staff record and leave
hr_officer.steps: Open a staff record; approve or reject a leave request.
hr_officer.expected: The decision is recorded and the staff member's leave balance updates.

camp_coordinator.title: Plan a health camp
camp_coordinator.steps: Camp Management → new camp → add date, site, team.
camp_coordinator.expected: The camp appears in the list and can register attendees.

marketing_executive.title: Create a campaign
marketing_executive.expected: The campaign is listed; no patient clinical records are visible to marketing.

scheduling_admin.title: Set a doctor's OPD schedule
scheduling_admin.steps: Set clinic days and slot length for a doctor.
scheduling_admin.expected: Appointments can be booked only in those slots.

case_manager.title: Assign a case
case_manager.steps: Case Management → assign an admitted patient to yourself → add a note.
case_manager.expected: The assignment and note are listed.

utilization_reviewer.title: Review a long stay
utilization_reviewer.steps: Utilization Review → open a review → record the decision.
utilization_reviewer.expected: The decision is saved with your name.

occ_health_officer.title: Employee health check
occ_health_officer.steps: Occupational Health → record a staff fitness check.
occ_health_officer.expected: It is saved to that staff member's occupational record.

delivery_runner.title: Deliver a pharmacy order
delivery_runner.steps: Home Deliveries → an assigned delivery → picked up → delivered.
delivery_runner.expected: Status updates with times; only the address needed for delivery is visible.

display_device.title: Waiting-room board
display_device.steps: Sign in and open Token Board.
display_device.expected: Tokens show and update when called; nothing else in the app is reachable.
